name: Hardware-assisted Volume Deformation
aliases: Deformed Volume Rendering via Inverse Deformation in Fragment Shaders
definition: A method for rendering deformed volumes by integrating the deformation process into the volume rendering pipeline. Instead of pre-computing the deformed volume, the rendering process replaces evaluations of the undeformed volume v with the deformed volume v' = v ∘ u, where u is the inverse deformation function.
summary: Hardware-assisted Volume Deformation renders deformed volumes by evaluating an inverse deformation function per-pixel in the fragment shader, enabling interactive rates without pre-computing a resampled volume.
